proposedImplementation.contracts: Reuse Rox2EntityRef, Rox2ExternalBinding, Rox2RelationKind and status triad. Define strict entity.link schema with from/to/relationKind/sourceKey and no body actor; RegisterEntity includes typed kind and optional provider binding/import provenance; GetBacklinks takes workspace-scoped target, bounded limit and actor-authorized opaque cursor. Results carry canonical ref/revision, receipt and typed link provenance with no denied titles/totals. Confirm additional operation names/routes with lead because spec only fixes entity.link HTTP/nativeRpc names.
proposedImplementation.commands: RegisterEntity, LinkEntity and GetBacklinks execute through accepted actor/policy/idempotency/revision gateway. Recheck both refs and account aliases inside mutation transaction. Reject route/envelope/ref workspace mismatch and unknown relation kinds before helper calls. Authorize before receipt/query serialization. LinkEntity validates kind pair via isAllowedRox2Relation and forbidden cycle via wouldCreateRelationCycle on the transaction's workspace-and-kind graph. Serialize concurrent acyclic link writes by workspace+relation kind using accepted DB lock/serializable retry port; endpoint-only locks do not prevent all long-cycle races. Store one directed edge with relationKind/sourceKey provenance; incoming backlinks read that same edge rather than persisting a reversed copy.
proposedImplementation.repository: One service authority: entity PK(workspace_id,entity_id), alias UNIQUE(workspace_id,provider,account,remote_type,remote_id) with composite entity FK, link composite endpoint FKs and provenance-aware unique edge key agreed with lead. Index target/type and stable cursor sort. Preserve schema version, nonnegative revision, timestamps and retained tombstones. Concurrent same-binding create converges on the existing canonical alias target; do not regenerate the target as proof of collision. Use one transaction for graph rows, immutable command receipt and outbox events; inbox consumption/replay uses common foundation. Persist conflicting/ambiguous import candidate and provenance in the accepted receipt/import quarantine mechanism without overwriting canonical alias, inventing another registry or adding nonnormative files.
proposedImplementation.migration: Additive backfill only after WP-01 workspace keys/migrator accepted; reuse encoded four-slot parsing for legacy aliases and preserve accepted historical canonical IDs. Ambiguous five-plus-slot keys or unknown-version payloads are retained/quarantined, never guessed or discarded. Ordinary same remote ID in different workspace/account is distinct, not a global collision. Snapshot and writer-route restoration before cutover; after accepted shared writes use forward repair/verified reverse replay, never remove recent writes.
proposedImplementation.tests: Future wp-02.test.ts exercises actual composed graph service/storage gateway, not pure helper echoes. Cover binding retry/concurrent retry, legacy alias second retry, same remote ID across accounts/workspaces, collision retention, directed edge/backlink parity, endpoint ACL, cross-workspace denial, per-kind cycle policy and concurrent long cycle, revision/idempotency conflict, restart after commit before reply, duplicate/reordered/dropped events and tombstone fence. Seed 20260932; independent negative control omits account namespace and independent holdout variant bypasses target ACL or cycle enforcement. UI/native agent proof is separate and mandatory.
